author: Ar_513
quote:
-The story of this game is abysmal and full of cliches, it’s a stain to previous protagonist stories. The protagonist are unlikeable and poorly written. Trevor was unlikeable but he was written with nuance. His violent behavior and personality in GTAV stems from severe childhood abuse, chronic abandonment, and deep betrayal from people who were his closest friends. Rockstar also did the Bonny and Clyde gimmick better with Claude and Catalina a quarter century ago in GTAIII.
-Lack of repayable missions. 
-Can’t explore free roam after the ending. 
-Attempt at realism get in the way of fun. Running around completing chores is not fun it’s just busywork. 
-The game shipped in a buggy unifinished mess. 
-Game is locked at 30FPS because the physics are tied to the framrate.

+Hunting and Fishing and animal variety is really good.
+Good music on the radio.

This is not GTA just like new bf6 is not battlefield. All the people that made the games left and R* is now an empty husk just like DICE is today.
